computational_refinement: Shared item-audience binary MinHash to approximate already registered ItemCF Jaccard on fixed candidates; query own-user exclusion via proposed two distinct minima per coordinate.
dedup_existing: HYP046 exact sharing does not cover approximate equality
existing_sketch_search: Bounded canonical searches found no explicit MinHash/sketch entry; absence is not claimed as academic novelty. Jaccard is explicitly prior ItemCF P1.
mechanism: Binary view-user sets share coordinate hash/permutation identity. Per-item sketches feed history mean/max compatibility on C. Two minima/IDs permit one specified query-user deletion; not arbitrary deletions.
prediction: Finite collision estimates can reverse a true Jaccard ranking and cannot certify support; Jaccard and cosine rankings can differ even before approximation. Daily banks need whole-window rebuilding or additional state for expiry.

nearest_unrun_falsifier.after_two_expiries_A_minimum: 1; unavailable from stored initial top-two minima alone

task1_benefit: Test complete cost/approximation tradeoff for a typed compatibility primitive; do not claim automated feature quality from sketch correctness.
exact_control: Same binary Jaccard definition, snapshot/history/own exclusion/NULL/aggregation/Q/C/fullY. A bounded exact set control checks distortion. Complete optimized exact uses sorted postings once and caches pre-personal-subtraction unique requested intersections.
exact_control_cost: Global scan/filter and distinct edge build/sort paid once; postings O(D), unique-pair intersections O(sum_Z(d_i+d_j)) for Z<=R. Source selected item domains and cache permissions must be symmetrically declared; no dense item-item matrix.
strong_quality_control: Eligible B/W same future procedure/context. Existing revealed October final supplies no new selection/quality test. Both any future feature/control model preparations, fits, scores and failures are paid under separate reservation, currently unknown/ungranted.
chronology: Graph snapshot [s-7d,s), s<t; actual bank available_at<=t. Item audiences include eligible users outside Q. User history [t-7d,t), <=20 distinct IDs, no diagonal. Same-time event peers excluded. Early left truncation is coverage, not a complete week. All warm-up source and bank versions charged.
self_exclusion: Proposed top-two distinct IDs per coordinate switches to second only if first ID=u; exact item degrees and own-membership removed consistently. Finite hash ties require deterministic total order and full common identity. Ordinary datasketch stores hash minima only and does not implement this extension.
support: Exact c>=3 threshold/shrinkage cannot be retained from collisions alone. Need paid exact verification or explicit approximate/unthresholded feature contract matched to an exact version of that same definition; do not call estimated support exact.
finite_cost: E event visits, D distinct item-user edges, I represented items, k coordinates, R<=20*sum|Cq|: O(kE) sketch processing, O(2kI) sketch-only state plus O(k) shared identity; O(kR) comparison. Degrees/dedup/rolling expiry may retain O(D) state. V bank versions multiply state; no whole pipeline O(kI) claim. Global source/auth/hash/history lookup/index/native work/build/warm-up/spill/export/sink/oracle/failures paid.
weighted_branch: Deferred; Ioffe CWS targets sum min / sum max over nonnegative weights. It is not cosine or the already proposed weighted cosine. Event-count weights are sensitive to repeated logging.
uncertainty: Collision interpretation uses minwise/randomness assumptions. No exact binomial or unbiasedness guarantee is asserted for installed code: v1.6.5 uses finite32-bit hashed values and affine permutation family. No implementation installed or timed.
